tasks.title: The Moon
tasks.text: The Moon is the only natural satellite of the Earth, and it is the brightest object in the night sky. It does not produce light of its own: we see it because it reflects the light of the Sun. The Moon travels around the Earth in about a month, which is why its shape seems to change from a thin crescent to a full circle and back again. It also affects our planet, because its gravity causes the tides in the oceans. In 1969, astronauts landed on the Moon for the first time, and since then people have kept dreaming of returning.
